'''Forgotten Sword''' is a [[unique item|unique]] [[sword]] traded by the [[Keeper of Steel]], a [[collector]] who can be found in the [[Throne of Secrets]].

== Stats ==
: [[Slashing damage]]: 15-22 (Requires 9 [[Swordsmanship]])
: [[Damage]] +15% (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
: [[Armor penetration]] +20% (Chance: 20%)
: Health +30
